rows.title: AI software engineer
rows.eligibility: Tier 1 - verbatim: 'This is a REMOTE position. We only accept candidates located in EU, Norway, UK, and Switzerland.' Italy is inside the stated set and inside the +/-2h band; his EU long-term residence permit already satisfies it with no sponsorship.
rows.posted: not disclosed on posting (single live posting fetched 2026-08-05)
rows.why: Asks 2+ years of core LLM engineering in Python plus TypeScript/JavaScript against OpenAI and Anthropic APIs - the exact shape of the production AI agents he shipped at FlowSpace (support agents, the n8n + Eden AI CV parser) rather than a research role. Small AI-native team where one person owns an agent end to end, which is how he has worked for three years.
rows.watch_outs: No comp and no posted date disclosed - ask for the band early. Braintrust/Langfuse eval tooling and Pydantic/async framework depth are named and are the parts of the JD he cannot yet evidence; worth naming his eval approach in the cover note. Insurance-domain AI, so expect domain questions.
rows.verified: fetched 2026-08-05 via WebFetch of the single Greenhouse EU posting (rendered as one job, not the board index) - live

rows.title: GTM Engineer
rows.location: Europe - remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona
rows.eligibility: Tier 1 - verbatim: 'Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona.' EU-based candidates; Italy qualifies and no permit question arises.
rows.posted: not disclosed on posting (single live posting fetched 2026-08-05)
rows.why: Wants 3-5 years building growth/revenue automation with Claude, OpenAI, Cursor, Replit, Clay, HubSpot and BigQuery - this is his unusual overlap: an engineer who has actually built sales-funnel automations, lead enrichment and CRM lead-capture integrations at FlowSpace and Urlink. The Cursor/Replit prototyping bias also rewards his Bubble-to-production speed rather than penalising it.
rows.watch_outs: GTM engineering sits closer to revenue ops than to product engineering, so it can narrow his next move if he wants to stay a builder. No comp or date disclosed. Travel-API company, so expect data-volume questions rather than agent questions.
rows.verified: fetched 2026-08-05 via WebFetch of the single Greenhouse posting (rendered as one job, not the board index) - live

rows.title: AI Platform Engineer (EU/UK Based - Remote)
rows.location: Remote, EU/UK - London primary, Prague secondary
rows.eligibility: Tier 1 - org API returns isRemote=true with EU/UK residency in the title and London/Prague as the listed locations; an EU-resident contractor/employee is in scope. Non-EU company (UK) but hiring EU-wide remotely.
rows.why: Duvo is 'the AI operations platform for retail and CPG enterprises' where AI agents execute work across systems instead of people copying data between them - which is a product description of what he did at FlowSpace with Office RnD, Nexudus and CRM integrations. Salary band is disclosed and wide, and EU/UK remote is stated in the title rather than implied.
rows.watch_outs: Published 2025-10-22, so ~9 months old even though the board still lists it - treat as evergreen and confirm it is actively staffed before investing in the application. The €110-220K band is identical across every Duvo role, so it carries little information about level. 'Platform Engineer' may skew more infrastructure than agent-building; their Product Engineer opening on the same board is the safer fallback if the screen goes that way.

rows.title: GTM Engineer (Remote)
rows.eligibility: Tier 1 - posting states 'Remote (Global)'. Worldwide eligibility on its face; the hiring entity is not European, so the mechanism is likely contractor or EOR rather than local payroll.
rows.posted: not disclosed on posting (single live posting fetched 2026-08-05)
rows.why: 3-6 years and the brief is building 'GTM Agents' - AI agents that run enrichment, sequencing and pipeline work - at an enterprise AI company. That is his outbound/lead-enrichment automation experience pointed at agents, and the year band is squarely his.
rows.watch_outs: 'Remote (Global)' is the claim, not a verified eligibility sentence naming countries - confirm they can engage an Italian contractor (Partita IVA invoicing, W-8BEN if the paying entity is US) before going deep. Salesforce is the anchor system and he has no Salesforce depth. A .com-host twin of this posting is already closed, so apply through this .eu URL. Likely US/Israel-hours overlap expectation.

rows.title: Applied AI Engineer (Fullstack), AI Co-Innovation
rows.eligibility: Tier 3 + Relocation - posting names Norway (Oslo) and states no remote option. Norway is outside the EU, so his EU long-term residence permit does not cover working there; needs a move and a Norwegian permit.
rows.posted: not disclosed on posting (single live posting fetched 2026-08-05)
rows.why: Applied AI plus fullstack plus 'low-code AI agents' in one role is an unusually exact read of his CV - the Bubble.io-to-Next.js/Laravel migration plus shipped agents plus API integration depth, with no year count demanded. Co-innovation work is client-facing prototyping, which is what he did mediating between FlowSpace and its external agency.
rows.watch_outs: Relocation to Oslo and a non-EU work permit are the whole risk here; only worth the application if he would genuinely move. No remote sentence, no comp, no date. Cognite is a large industrial-AI scale-up, so expect a longer, more structured loop than the startups above.

rows.title: GTM Engineer, AI & Automation
rows.location: United States (company is globally distributed, 20+ countries)
rows.eligibility: Tier 3 + Sponsorship/relocation risk - the posting location is United States and both bands are USD; the only geography sentence is 'ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly', which is not an eligibility statement. Included because ClickHouse does employ across 20+ countries, so an EU-based variant is worth one email before writing it off.
rows.comp: $145,000 - $195,000 USD standard market; $165,000 - $225,000 USD premium market (disclosed)
rows.posted: not disclosed on posting (single live posting fetched 2026-08-05)
rows.why: The only posting in this whole sweep that names n8n outright, alongside Clay, Langfuse, LLM APIs, agent frameworks and embeddings - his sharpest differentiator and his GTM-automation background in a single JD, at a company with real engineering credibility and a disclosed band.
rows.watch_outs: Asks 5+ years, at the top of his realistic band. US-located posting with USD-only comp, so establish EU eligibility before investing. dbt and vector-search work sits at the edge of what he can evidence. Expect US working-hours overlap.
